newsitem.title: USA: Fred Meyer names Jessick CFO.
newsitem.headline: Fred Meyer names Jessick CFO.

text.p: Fred Meyer Inc Wednesday named David Jessick to the post of chief financial officer, replacing Kenneth Thrasher who was promoted to executive vice president and chief administrative officer.

In a statement the company said Thrasher, 47, fills a new position and consolidates responsibility for the administrative side of the company, including finance and accounting, management information systems, human resources, public affairs, and asset management.
Jessick, 43, was formerly executive vice president and chief financial officer of Thrifty Pay Less Holdings Inc, where he spent nearly 18 years prior to its acquisition in late 1996 by Rite Aid Corp.
